transcript.statement: The TrustworthinessAgent emphasizes the necessity of robust security measures to protect sensitive financial data. TRU-01 ensures encryption during transmission and storage, safeguarding against unauthorized access. TRU-02 establishes role-based access control, which is crucial for limiting permissions and enhancing data integrity. TRU-03 mandates an immutable audit trail for accountability. TRU-04 prevents malicious data entry, while TRU-05 enforces two-factor authentication for user access. TRU-06 logs user access for transparency, and TRU-07 restricts data access to relevant accounts. Together, these requirements ensure a secure and trustworthy bookkeeping system.

conflicts_raised.description: TRU-03's requirement for a minimum 5-year audit trail conflicts with SAF-03's 7-year retention, creating a logical inconsistency in audit trail duration.

transcript.statement: The ResponsibilityAgent emphasizes the importance of ethical compliance and accountability in the bookkeeping system. RES-01 ensures adherence to financial regulations, while RES-02 establishes user access controls to prevent unauthorized modifications. RES-03 maintains a transparent audit trail, crucial for accountability. RES-04 detects potential discrepancies, promoting fairness. RES-05 ensures compliance with accounting standards, and RES-06 allows users to report ethical concerns confidentially. RES-07 provides multi-currency support with transparent exchange rates, ensuring fairness in international transactions. Together, these requirements uphold ethical standards and regulatory compliance in financial reporting.

requirements.text: The system shall ensure compliance with applicable financial regulations and standards to guarantee legal accountability.
The system shall implement user access controls to ensure that only authorized personnel can modify transactions.
The system shall maintain an audit trail of all transactions for a minimum of 7 years.
The system shall provide error handling mechanisms to manage and recover from faults during transaction processing.
The system shall ensure that all financial transactions are recorded accurately to prevent data loss or corruption.
The system shall support safe degradation, ensuring that users can access essential functionalities even during partial outages.
The system shall validate currency conversions to ensure accuracy and prevent financial discrepancies.
The system shall ensure that all financial transactions are processed within 2 seconds to optimize responsiveness.
The system shall support concurrent processing of at least 100 users to ensure adequate throughput.
The system shall utilize efficient data structures to minimize memory usage by 30% compared to traditional methods.
The system shall generate financial reports in under 5 seconds for datasets up to 10,000 transactions.
The system shall implement caching for frequently accessed data to reduce latency by at least 50%.
The system shall ensure that currency conversion operations complete within 3 seconds for real-time transactions.
The system shall maintain an audit trail that logs each transaction with a maximum logging delay of 1 second.
The system shall minimize energy consumption during data processing by using efficient algorithms and data structures.
The system shall implement cloud-based solutions to reduce the carbon footprint associated with local server maintenance.
The system shall support document digitization to reduce paper usage by at least 80%.
The system shall track the lifecycle resource impact of accounting features to identify areas for improvement.
The system shall provide users with sustainability reports showing energy and resource consumption metrics.
The system shall enable users to offset carbon emissions from transactions through integrated carbon credit options.
The system shall ensure compliance with sustainability regulations and standards relevant to financial systems.
The system shall ensure that all financial transactions are encrypted during transmission and storage.
The system shall validate data input to prevent unauthorized or malicious data entry.
The system shall support two-factor authentication for all users accessing financial data.
The system shall log all user access and modifications to data, retaining logs for review.
The system shall ensure that users can only access data relevant to their assigned accounts and categories.
